title: hubSessionMessages
responsibility: Write and read the Tracker notes that carry a Hub message, its delivery receipt and the session's keyed reply, and fold them into one thread.

inputs.name: hubMessageLine.text
inputs.description: Text from Daniel or a session, possibly with line breaks or control characters.

inputs.name: hubMessageId.itemId
inputs.description: The Tracker item that holds the thread.

inputs.name: hubMessageId.uuid
inputs.description: The Hub's message UUID; its first 8 hex digits name the message.

inputs.name: hubMessageItem.messageId
inputs.description: A Hub message id such as <item>-<8 hex>.

inputs.name: hubMessageTargetLabel.target
inputs.description: Chief of Staff's pane or one exact run (computer and run number).

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.messageId
inputs.description: The Hub message id.

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.target
inputs.description: Where the message must be delivered.

inputs.name: formatHubMessageNote.text
inputs.description: Daniel's message.

inputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote.messageId
inputs.description: The Hub message id.

inputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote.session
inputs.description: The tmux session the message was typed into.

inputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote.messageId
inputs.description: The Hub message id.

inputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote.reason
inputs.description: Why it will never be delivered.

inputs.name: formatHubReplyNote.messageId
inputs.description: The Hub message being answered.

inputs.name: formatHubReplyNote.text
inputs.description: The session's reply.

inputs.name: hubPaneMessage.messageId
inputs.description: The Hub message id the session replies to.

inputs.name: hubPaneMessage.text
inputs.description: Daniel's message.

inputs.name: parseHubMessageNote.text
inputs.description: The text of one Tracker note.

inputs.name: hubSessionMessages.notes
inputs.description: An item's notes, oldest first, each with its time and text.

outputs.name: hubMessageIdPattern
outputs.description: Matches a Hub message id and captures its thread item.

outputs.name: hubMessageLine
outputs.description: One line without control characters.

outputs.name: hubMessageId
outputs.description: The message id <item>-<8 hex>, or null when the item id is not a Tracker id.

outputs.name: hubMessageItem
outputs.description: The thread item of a message id, or null for anything else.

outputs.name: hubMessageTargetLabel
outputs.description: "Chief of Staff" or "run <computer>#<run>".

outputs.name: formatHubMessageNote
outputs.description: The note that stores the message for its target.

outputs.name: formatHubDeliveredNote
outputs.description: The receipt note written once the pane showed the message submitted.

outputs.name: formatHubRefusedNote
outputs.description: The note recording that the message was not and will not be delivered.

outputs.name: formatHubReplyNote
outputs.description: The note holding the session's reply to that message.

outputs.name: hubPaneMessage
outputs.description: The single line typed into the pane, starting with "Message from Daniel via Hub" and ending with the exact tracker reply command.

outputs.name: parseHubMessageNote
outputs.description: The message, delivered, refused or reply event, or null for any other note.

outputs.name: hubSessionMessages
outputs.description: Each message with its status (stored, delivered, acknowledged or refused), receipt details and replies.
